lead: The FBI arrests a ransomware negotiator tied to ShinyHunters, the White House mandates AI incident disclosure, and Prime Intellect's own agent swarm rewrites its harness in Rust.

sections.title: The ShinyHunters probe reaches a negotiator
sections.intro: The FBI arrests a ransomware-negotiation firm co-founder in Pennsylvania, and the case moves to Texas.

sections.title: Rules, power and politics
sections.intro: The White House mandates AI incident disclosure, and Cory Doctorow argues against unthwarted billionaires.

sections.title: An agent rewrites itself in Rust
sections.intro: Prime Intellect's agent swarm ports its own harness from TypeScript to Rust.

sections.title: Chips and cloud capital
sections.intro: A guilty plea in the Super Micro smuggling case, and a $445M round for on-premise cloud.
